method: Full selected reader/runner/ten-mock source, AST, exact reverse and JSON/hash inspection only. No prepared imports/tests/reader execution, MSH/BIN/native runtime bytes, native/scientific calls, Git or network.

exact_reuse.reader_delta: Only stopped native-HXT directory changes to assembled-volume-hxt-001; no geometry, metric, gate, count or boundary predicate change.

binding_observations.OUT_ROOT: Exact reader/runner copies must execute at declared same-depth fresh output location; ROOT parents[3] and OUT bind frozen-contract.json, not preparation location.

reader_checks.input_runtime_and_drift: Complete actual input map, surface-admission input map and executed source/snapshot hashes before reads; exact Gmsh4.15.2/module/library/interpreter/arm64 checks; complete pins/admission/runtime checked again before fresh report write.
reader_checks.full_saved_observations: All sorted tagged node/coordinate/tetra arrays hashed against stopped worker; full explicit source-boundary coordinates/connectivity equality. Complete native SICN/Jacobian/volume arrays queried in100000-cell chunks with count/finiteness/extrema/nonpositive bookkeeping and separate exact SICN<0.1 count. Complete signed tetra-volume and referenced/orphan-node census remains unchanged.
reader_checks.no_geometry_generation: Only existing saved-MSH open/read and native quality queries; no generate/optimize/geometry write/solve calls. Any incomplete/nonfinite/missing-node/unexpected diagnostic row causes refusal before final report.
reader_checks.diagnostic_zero: Current9a648 native quality metadata has zero nonpositive counts; held maximum_nonpositive_cells=0 is derived from that current report. Reader refuses any unexpected nonpositive row without silently truncating. all(empty) fixed-boundary result is explicitly vacuous; it does not locate or qualify positive poor cells.
reader_checks.quality_and_attribution: SICN>=0.1 threshold remains unchanged; source neutral completion can report false quality gate. Tetra-exterior face incidence and internal-face orientation remain explicitly retained native observations, not repeated by this reader.

runner_checks.deadline: Timestamp precedes Popen; timer uses max(0,120-elapsed), including creation delay. A synchronous elapsed>=120 latch after protected cleanup refuses valid RC0/report even if zero timer callback never runs. No automatic retry.
runner_checks.cleanup: Nonraising SIGTERM flag retains assignment ownership; timer cancellation, live owned process-group stop, wait/reap and nested finally handler restoration remain byte-reused. Exceptions propagate and cannot become success solely through receipt fields.
runner_checks.mock_coverage: Prior eight signal/Popen/timer/monitor/wait/normal checks retained; new17s-creation test expects103s timer and late121s valid/exited/no-callback test expects RC2 deadline. Source SHA guard and resolved temporary roots preserved.
runner_checks.resource_scope: 120s acceptance/watchdog budget, sampled4GiB RSS and two software threads. No hard OS CPU/address-space quota, exact peak-RSS, blocked-Popen cancellation or bounded cleanup-duration guarantee is established.

required_before_actual_readback: Root materializes exact sources and a separately authorized fresh actual contract, including this peer and root mock/runtime/large-file prerequisites; source preparation alone grants no execution authority.
Root verifies complete current MSH/BIN/runtime identities, fresh outputs and exact actual-child SHA under its external launch guard.

Stopped outcome must distinguish direct readback completion from unchanged SICN0.1 rejection; no accepted volume, thermal resolution, convergence, PDE, OEM, material, strength, LPBF or manufacturing qualification.
